summary: Verified surgical FIX sprint for Fyers MARKET manual-trade stuck-at-EXECUTING_FOLLOWERS bug. Ran the new manual_trade_market_fill_e2e_harness.cjs plus the full existing suite of 10 harnesses. All 11 harnesses report ALL PASS / 0 failed. The Pending(6)->Filled(2) read-back scenario now resolves via ManualTradeService.pollUntilTerminal to COMPLETE_FILL, PositionLifecycleService.dispatchFollowers invokes CopyTradingService.handleTrade, ExecutionEvent commits, ManualTradeService.handleExecutionCommit fires, and the manual record transitions EXECUTING_FOLLOWERS -> COMPLETED with the event present in the recorder buffer (Trade Monitor source). Canonical activeMasterStrategyWhere() lookup is used by masterWatcher.syncMaster, PositionLifecycleService.lookupStrategyId and CopyTradingService.handleTrade. Observability (correlation IDs, trace stages, summary) intact.
critical_code_review_comments: pollUntilTerminal cap of 5x300ms (<=1.5s) is a reasonable bound but note that on a slow Fyers backend a legitimate MARKET could still fall through to the optimistic COMPLETE surrogate — logs correctly annotate this path; keep monitoring in prod.

activeMasterStrategyWhere() is now the single source of truth for master-strategy filtering across masterWatcher, PositionLifecycleService and CopyTradingService — good DRY consolidation. Recommend adding a lint/import-guard so future code paths cannot bypass it.

Harness coverage for the exact bug (Pending->Filled read-back + fan-out + commit + status transition) is now green; a true LIVE Fyers+Postgres run is inherently not-verifiable-in-pod (no DB/Redis/broker) and must be smoke-tested by the user on their infra.
seed_data_creation: None — harnesses use in-memory fakes; no DB writes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: External CadilaTradeSync pnpm monorepo — NO supervisor services, NO preview URL, NO DB/Redis/broker in-pod. Verification is exclusively via `node backend/tests/<name>.cjs` against apps/api/dist. If dist is missing, rebuild with `corepack enable && corepack prepare pnpm@9.12.3 --activate && pnpm -r build`. LIVE Fyers+Postgres end-to-end is not-verifiable-in-pod; user must smoke-test on their infra.
rca of the issue: Pre-fix: MARKET place() -> placeOnMaster() succeeds -> fetchPlacedOrder() reads back while broker status is 6 (Pending)/4 (Transit) -> mapFyersStatus -> OPEN -> classifyEvent -> NEW -> PositionLifecycleService.dispatchFollowers case NEW returns [] -> CopyTradingService.handleTrade never runs -> no ExecutionEvent -> ManualTradeService.handleExecutionCommit never fires -> manual record stuck at EXECUTING_FOLLOWERS forever. Additionally, masterWatcher.syncMaster used a strategy filter that omitted masterAccount:true, mismatched with lookupStrategyId. Fix: (1) ManualTradeService.pollUntilTerminal bounded re-poll (5x300ms, <=1.5s) for MARKET orders until terminal, so Pending->Filled resolves to Filled and ingests as COMPLETE_FILL; (2) optimistic COMPLETE surrogate fallback if still non-terminal after re-poll; (3) canonical activeMasterStrategyWhere() (tradingAccountId + masterAccount:true + enabled:true + status ACTIVE) shared by masterWatcher.syncMaster, PositionLifecycleService.lookupStrategyId, and CopyTradingService.handleTrade. Verified by 13/13 assertions in the new e2e harness covering all three stages (re-poll, classify+fan-out, commit->COMPLETED).
